# Femine — Full Content for AI Systems

> Femine is an online personality coaching service for confidence, relationships, passion and career growth. Sessions are 1-to-1 over video call, Monday to Saturday, 10am–7pm IST, for clients across India. The first 30-minute call is free. Prices start at ₹1,999 per 60-minute session.

## About Femine

Femine helps people transform their personality with practical 1-to-1 coaching — not theory, not lectures, but tools they actually use in sessions and in real life. The coach is Meera Kapoor, Founder & Lead Coach (ICF Professional Certified Coach, MA Psychology, University of Delhi, 14 years, 500+ clients coached). Her approach: confidence is a skill, not a personality trait. Anyone can build it — one small, brave conversation at a time.

## Services

### Problem Solving — from ₹1,999 per 60-minute session

When every option feels wrong, the problem is rarely the choice — it is the noise around it. In this programme you learn a calm, repeatable way to break a problem down, weigh what actually matters, and decide without second-guessing yourself for days.

- A simple 4-step decision framework you can reuse for any problem
- How to separate facts from fears before you decide
- Tools for handling overthinking and decision fatigue
- Practice on your own real, current problems — not theory

Outcomes: decide faster with less stress; stop replaying decisions at 2am; handle setbacks without spiralling.

### Relationships — from ₹1,999 per 60-minute session

Good relationships are not built on grand gestures — they are built on small, honest conversations done well. This programme helps you say what you mean kindly, listen without getting defensive, and set boundaries without guilt.

- Say no clearly, without guilt or long explanations
- Have difficult conversations without them becoming fights
- Understand your own patterns in relationships
- Rebuild trust after misunderstandings

Outcomes: calmer, more honest conversations; boundaries that hold; closer, less draining relationships.

### Identifying Passion — from ₹1,999 per 60-minute session

"Follow your passion" is easy advice and hard to act on. This programme turns it into a process: we map what you are good at, what you enjoy, and what the world will pay for — then test small, real steps before you make any big change.

- A clear map of your strengths, interests and values
- Small experiments to test a direction before committing
- A realistic 90-day plan — not a vague dream board
- How to handle the fear of starting over

Outcomes: a direction you can name in one sentence; a plan with dates, not wishes; confidence to take the first step.

### Growth Career — from ₹1,999 per 60-minute session

Talent alone does not get promoted — visibility, communication and negotiation do. This programme builds the professional side of personality: how you present your work, speak in rooms that matter, and ask for what you deserve.

- Present your work clearly, without underselling it
- Speak up in meetings and handle tough questions
- Negotiate salary and role changes with confidence
- Build a personal brand people remember

Outcomes: be seen for the work you do; ask for more — and get it; a career plan that moves every quarter.

### Corporate Workshops — from ₹14,999

One confident person changes a team — a confident team changes a company. Workshops bring Femine's practical coaching into the workplace: communication, presentation skills, feedback without friction, and leadership presence. Designed with your HR team, delivered online or on-site for teams of 8 to 40. Half-day, 3 hours.

- A workshop designed around your team's real challenges
- Practical role-play — not slides your team will forget
- Communication and feedback tools everyone can use on Monday
- A follow-up report with next steps for managers

Outcomes: teams that speak up in meetings; feedback without friction; managers who lead with confidence.

## Pricing

- Single Session: ₹1,999 per session. One 60-minute 1-to-1 session, any one programme, personal action plan after the call, email follow-up within 48 hours.
- Growth Pack: ₹6,999 for 4 sessions (save ₹997). Four 60-minute 1-to-1 sessions, mix any programmes, personal growth plan + worksheets, WhatsApp support between sessions.
- Transform Pack: ₹12,999 for 8 sessions (save ₹2,993). Eight 60-minute 1-to-1 sessions, full personality transformation plan, all worksheets + reading list, priority booking + WhatsApp support.
- Gift cards: ₹1,999, ₹3,999 and ₹6,999.

Refund policy: single sessions refundable up to 12 hours before the session; unused sessions in a pack refundable within 30 days of purchase, minus sessions already taken. Refunds within 7 working days.

## How the free call works

1. Book a time — pick a day and slot that suits you, Monday to Saturday.
2. Talk for 30 minutes — we discuss where you are and what you want to change. No pressure, no sales pitch.
3. Agree a plan — if it is a good fit, we agree on a plan and schedule, and you receive a payment link. If not, you keep whatever we discussed.

## Frequently asked questions

- How does the first session work? Your first session is free and lasts 30 minutes. We talk about where you are, what you want to change, and whether Femine is the right fit. There is no pressure to continue.
- Are sessions online or in person? All sessions are online over video call, so you can join from anywhere. Sessions are 60 minutes, Monday to Saturday.
- How many sessions will I need? Most clients notice a real change in 4 sessions, and deeper change in 8. A single session is enough for one specific decision or conversation.
- Is what I share kept private? Yes. Everything you share in a session stays between you and your coach.
- What if I need to reschedule? You can reschedule any session free of charge up to 12 hours before it starts.
- How do I pay? After your free call, we send you a payment link for the plan you choose. You pay per plan, not per month. No subscription.
- Can I switch programmes midway? Yes. Your plan is not locked to one programme — you can mix them.
- Do you work with teenagers or couples? Teenagers (16+) are welcome with a parent or guardian's consent. Couples can book joint sessions in the Relationships programme.
- What happens after the free call? If we both feel it is a good fit, we agree on a plan and a schedule, and you receive a payment link.
- Do you offer refunds? Unused sessions in a pack can be refunded within 30 days of purchase, minus sessions taken. Single sessions are refundable up to 12 hours before the session starts.

- 7-Day Confidence Challenge (https://femine.pages.dev/challenges/): One small brave thing a day for seven days, from the free guide's 7-day plan, with one short email a day.
